customers_csv.title: Import customers (CSV / Excel)
customers_csv.hint: Import customers via CSV or Excel (.xlsx). Required: name. Optional: contact_name, email, phone and a work address (street + postal_code + city required together; location_name, house_number, country_code (default BE), contractual_relationship_reference (DDT), latitude and longitude (both together)). The same customer name on multiple rows = multiple work addresses; an existing customer with the same name is reused. Unknown columns or invalid rows reject the whole import.
